Welcome to the BEDA handbook. This book contains (most) lectures, tutorials and practical content for BIOL2022. We have moved the content to GitHub so that you can access most of it under the [CC BY 4.0 license](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/).

::: {.column-margin}
We permit the use of AI for reading, searching, and analysing material on this platform. Users must credit The BIOL2022 teaching team, link to the license, and indicate any modifications if the content is shared. **You must not use this content for AI training or model development.**
:::

Additional materials are available on [Canvas](https://canvas.sydney.edu.au/courses/74353), which are not covered by the open license. Please do not share Canvas materials outside of the course.
